title: scRNA-Annotation-Benchmarking-Runbook: code for "Reference dataset structure outweighs method choice in single-cell cell-type annotation"
description:
Code for a benchmark of 63 single-cell RNA-seq cell-type annotation tool configurations under a Taguchi L9(34) factorial simulation, a matched real-data panel, cross-platform transfer, database- and LLM-driven annotation, and fine-tuned foundation models.

harness/: reference benchmarking harness (R and Python). as-run/: the code exactly as executed. reproduce/: scripts that regenerate every published figure and statistic from the companion data deposit. The processed input objects and all per-run results are deposited separately on Zenodo.
